title: Wilkins 720A repair kits by size, bonnet, and internal service
description: Match a Zurn Wilkins 720A pressure vacuum breaker to the manufacturer-published 1/2–1 inch or 1 1/4–2 inch repair-kit family before ordering parts.
summary: The 720A looks like one device family, but Zurn separates its repair-kit path at the 1 inch / 1 1/4 inch boundary. Confirm the body size first, then choose complete internal or bonnet service.
statusNote: Zurn positions the 720A for irrigation backflow protection. A correct kit does not resolve freeze-cracked bodies, incorrect installation height, or local testing and reporting requirements.
diagramAlt: Pressure vacuum breaker showing bonnet, atmospheric vent, check assembly, and test cocks
identifiers: Confirm the body label reads 720A; do not apply these parts to an unmarked look-alike or a different Wilkins PVB.
The published complete-kit boundary changes after 1 inch: RK1-720A is for 1/2–1 inch, while RK2-720A is for 1 1/4–2 inch assemblies.
A bonnet repair kit and a complete internal repair kit address different scopes; do not use a bonnet kit to assume the check and internal parts are serviceable.

kits.contents: Bonnet washer and O-ring, load nut and guide, load washer, upper disc, poppet, spring, spider screw, lower disc, guide spider, and hex nut.
kits.compatibility: Manufacturer-published for 1/2, 3/4, and 1 inch Model 720A pressure vacuum breakers.

kits.contents: Bonnet O-ring, load nut and guide, load washer, upper disc, and poppet.
kits.compatibility: Manufacturer-published for 1/2–1 inch 720A; compare its narrower component set with the complete RK1-720A kit.

kits.contents: Canopy screws, canopy, bonnet, bonnet washer, and bonnet O-ring.
kits.compatibility: Verify the actual 720A size and current Zurn instruction sheet before purchase; bonnet service does not include the full internal service set.

kits.contents: Bonnet washer and O-ring, load nut and guide, load washer, upper disc, poppet, spring, spider screw, lower disc, guide spider, and hex nut.
kits.compatibility: Manufacturer-published for 1 1/4, 1 1/2, and 2 inch Model 720A assemblies.

kits.contents: Canopy, bonnet, bonnet washer, bonnet O-ring, and related canopy hardware listed in the manufacturer repair-kit guide.
kits.compatibility: Manufacturer-published for the 1 1/4–2 inch 720A band; not the 1/2–1 inch complete-kit family.
